env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd w
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/anon$GOEXE ./l/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/anon$GOEXE
stdout '^anon-ok$'
logos build -o $WORK/bin/goanon$GOEXE ./g/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/goanon$GOEXE
stdout '^go-anon-ok$'
cd ..

cd neg
! logos build ./anon
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
! logos build ./holder
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
! logos build ./retanon
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
! logos build ./alias
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
! logos build ./generic
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
cd ..

cd gneg
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
cd ..

use (
	./l
	./g

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w/l/c/c.lgo --
package c

type Namer interface {
	const Get() int
}

func Use(x interface{ const Get() int }) int {
	return x.Get()
}

type Holder struct {
	Inner Namer
	Anon  interface{ const Get() int }
}

func NewNamer(n Namer) Namer {
	return n
}

func NewAnon(n interface{ const Get() int }) interface{ const Get() int } {
	return n
}

type Alias = Namer

type AnonAlias = interface{ const Get() int }

func AllNamed[T Namer](x T) int {
	return x.Get()
}

// Optional G0.MGet shape if the parser accepts const in constraint
// position (guarded, never blocking the core P0/R0/F shapes):
// func All[T interface{ const Get() int }](x T) int {
// 	return x.Get()
// }

-- w/l/p/p.lgo --
package p

import "example.com/l/c"

type Pure struct {
	V int
}

func (p Pure) Get() int {
	return p.V
}

func MakePure(v int) Pure {
	return Pure{V: v}
}

func MakePureNamer(v int) c.Namer {
	return MakePure(v)
}

func MakePureAnon(v int) c.AnonAlias {
	return MakePure(v)
}

type Mut struct {
	S []int
}

func (m Mut) Get() int {
	m.S[0] = 1
	return m.S[0]
}

func MakeMut(v int) Mut {
	return Mut{S: []int{v}}
}

-- w/l/q/q.lgo --
package q

import (
	"example.com/l/c"
	"example.com/l/p"
)

func ViaAnon(x interface{ const Get() int }) int {
	return x.Get()
}

func ViaHolder(h c.Holder) int {
	return h.Inner.Get() + h.Anon.Get()
}

func ViaReturnNamer(n c.Namer) int {
	return c.NewNamer(n).Get()
}

func ViaReturnAnon(x interface{ const Get() int }) int {
	return c.NewAnon(x).Get()
}

func ViaAlias(a c.Alias) int {
	return a.Get()
}

func ViaAnonAlias(a c.AnonAlias) int {
	return a.Get()
}

func ViaGeneric[T c.Namer](x T) int {
	return x.Get()
}

func ViaAllNamed(x p.Pure) int {
	return c.AllNamed(x)
}

func Run() string {
	pure := p.MakePure(7)
	if c.Use(pure) != 7 {
		return "bad-use"
	}
	if ViaAnon(pure) != 7 {
		return "bad-viaanon"
	}
	h := c.Holder{Inner: pure, Anon: pure}
	if ViaHolder(h) != 14 {
		return "bad-holder"
	}
	if ViaReturnNamer(pure) != 7 {
		return "bad-retnamer"
	}
	if ViaReturnAnon(pure) != 7 {
		return "bad-retanon"
	}
	if c.NewNamer(pure).Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-newnamer"
	}
	if c.NewAnon(pure).Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-newanon"
	}
	var a c.Alias = pure
	if ViaAlias(a) != 7 {
		return "bad-alias"
	}
	var aa c.AnonAlias = pure
	if ViaAnonAlias(aa) != 7 {
		return "bad-anonalias"
	}
	if p.MakePureNamer(7).Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-makenamer"
	}
	if p.MakePureAnon(7).Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-makeanon"
	}
	if ViaGeneric(pure) != 7 {
		return "bad-generic"
	}
	if ViaAllNamed(pure) != 7 {
		return "bad-allnamed"
	}
	if c.AllNamed(pure) != 7 {
		return "bad-allnamed-direct"
	}
	return "anon-ok"
}

-- w/l/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/l/q"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(q.Run())
}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- w/g/qq/qq.go --
package qq

import (
	"example.com/l/c"
	"example.com/l/p"
)

type G int

func (g G) Get() int { return int(g) }

func Run() string {
	pure := p.MakePure(7)
	var plain interface{ Get() int } = pure
	if plain.Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-plain"
	}
	var n c.Namer = pure
	if n.Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-namer"
	}
	if c.NewNamer(pure).Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-newnamer"
	}
	if c.Use(pure) != 7 {
		return "bad-use"
	}
	if c.Use(G(7)) != 7 {
		return "bad-g"
	}
	var m c.Namer = G(7)
	if m.Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-gnamer"
	}
	if c.NewNamer(G(7)).Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-gnew"
	}
	h := c.Holder{Inner: pure, Anon: pure}
	if h.Inner.Get()+h.Anon.Get() != 14 {
		return "bad-holder"
	}
	hg := c.Holder{Inner: G(7), Anon: G(7)}
	if hg.Inner.Get()+hg.Anon.Get() != 14 {
		return "bad-gholder"
	}
	var a c.Alias = pure
	if a.Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-alias"
	}
	var ag c.Alias = G(7)
	if ag.Get() != 7 {
		return "bad-galias"
	}
	return "go-anon-ok"
}

-- w/g/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/g/qq"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(qq.Run()) }

-- neg/c/c.lgo --
package c

type Namer interface {
	const Get() int
}

func Use(x interface{ const Get() int }) int {
	return x.Get()
}

type Holder struct {
	Inner Namer
	Anon  interface{ const Get() int }
}

func NewNamer(n Namer) Namer {
	return n
}

func NewAnon(n interface{ const Get() int }) interface{ const Get() int } {
	return n
}

type Alias = Namer

type AnonAlias = interface{ const Get() int }

func AllNamed[T Namer](x T) int {
	return x.Get()
}

// Optional G0.MGet shape if the parser accepts const in constraint
// position (guarded, never blocking the core P0/R0/F shapes):
// func All[T interface{ const Get() int }](x T) int {
// 	return x.Get()
// }

-- neg/anon/anon.lgo --
package anon

import "example.com/neg/c"

type Mut struct {
	S []int
}

func (m Mut) Get() int {
	m.S[0] = 1
	return m.S[0]
}

func Attack() int {
	return c.Use(Mut{S: []int{1}})
}

-- neg/holder/holder.lgo --
package holder

import "example.com/neg/c"

type Pure struct {
	V int
}

func (p Pure) Get() int {
	return p.V
}

type Mut struct {
	S []int
}

func (m Mut) Get() int {
	m.S[0] = 1
	return m.S[0]
}

func Attack() int {
	h := c.Holder{Inner: Pure{V: 1}, Anon: Mut{S: []int{1}}}
	return h.Inner.Get() + h.Anon.Get()
}

-- neg/retanon/retanon.lgo --
package retanon

import "example.com/neg/c"

type Mut struct {
	S []int
}

func (m Mut) Get() int {
	m.S[0] = 1
	return m.S[0]
}

func Attack() int {
	return c.NewAnon(Mut{S: []int{1}}).Get()
}

-- neg/alias/alias.lgo --
package alias

import "example.com/neg/c"

type Mut struct {
	S []int
}

func (m Mut) Get() int {
	m.S[0] = 1
	return m.S[0]
}

func Attack() int {
	var a c.AnonAlias = Mut{S: []int{1}}
	return a.Get()
}

-- neg/generic/generic.lgo --
package generic

import "example.com/neg/c"

type Mut struct {
	S []int
}

func (m Mut) Get() int {
	m.S[0] = 1
	return m.S[0]
}

func Attack() int {
	return c.AllNamed(Mut{S: []int{1}})
}

module example.com/gneg

require example.com/l v0.0.0

replace example.com/l => ../w/l

-- gneg/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/l/c"

type Mut struct {
	S []int
}

func (m Mut) Get() int {
	m.S[0] = 1
	return m.S[0]
}

func main() {
	println(c.Use(Mut{S: []int{1}}))
}
